messages:
mira: Heads-up — I'm sketching a 'debug runway' flow so support can temporarily get unredacted request/response pairs for an individual tenant without opening a full incident. Want quick feedback on safety, UX, and cost controls.

alex: Neat. high-level: ephemeral token + HMAC bind + audit trail?

mira: Exactly. Token minted from console, TTL limited (e.g. 10m), routes scoped, and HMAC header used by ingest to allow bypass of redaction for that specific tenant+route. Must surface in console audit and retention shortened.

jonah: Two quick risks: 1) token leak -> large blast radius, 2) unredacted storage costs. We should KMS-encrypt token metadata and only store an HMAC verifier in DB.

sophie: Agree on verifier-only storage. For cost, we should auto-sample after unredact window: full unredact for the TTL, then immediately mark logs as sampled 0.1% for longer retention, unless customer opts in. Console should show the projected S3/ES cost before mint.

mira: UX idea: console modal shows a simple slider: Duration (5m/10m/30m) + Scope (routes + example request id) + cost estimate. Hits 'Create debug runway' -> creates ephemeral token and a one-line audit entry.

alex: Implementation sketch for ingest check:
```http
POST /v1/request
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
  X-Debug-Runway: dbg_eyJ...  # opaque token
  X-Debug-HMAC: sha256=abcdef123456
```
Ingest validates HMAC against stored verifier for tenant and route and checks expiry. If valid, bypass redaction for this request.

jonah: Suggestion: sign per-request using a 2-step: console mints short-lived runway token and a server-side nonce. Ingest requires HMAC(token||nonce||request_id) so tokens alone are useless if captured. Nonce rotates per-minute.

sophie: That helps. But adding nonce increases complexity for existing proxies. How about a simpler strike: require tenant-side approval via an OTP to the tenant's admin email to mint runway? Then make the token single-use.

mira: Love the approval step for high-risk tenants. For automation (SRE or support), we can allow an exemption flag but require audit & manager approval in the flow.

alex: Audit concerns: we should log who minted, who used, and the exact request_ids unredacted. Also create an immutable export for legal when runway was used.

jonah: On the telemetry side, add metrics: runway_creates, runway_uses, runway_bypassed_bytes. Tag by tenant, route, env. We should also set alert if runway_uses per-tenant > N/day.

sophie: Cost calc: sample numbers — 1 unredacted minute for a high-throughput route could be tens of GB. Console cost tooltip should warn and require explicit ack for > X GB.

mira: Ops question: how do we surface revoked tokens across ingest fleet quickly? We'll need a push invalidation (pubsub) plus a short local cache (TTL 30s) to avoid stale allowlist.

alex: Pubsub + versioned allowlist + per-host cache sounds right. Worst-case fallback: if invalidation lagging, ingest should default to redaction if any TTL inconsistency — prefer safe-by-default.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout plan posted: https://go.redwood.tools/rfcs/debug-runway -> canary to staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC, prod canary 09:00 Fri.

mira: Nice. Can we get a quick API schema for the console? Minimal fields: tenant_id, routes[], duration_secs, reason, approver_email (optional). Also add a required `cost_ack` boolean for cost > threshold.

jonah: Security checklist for RFC: KMS key usage, key rotation, single-use token option, nonce design, audit export TTL, per-tenant rate limits, and retention policy for unredacted slices.

sophie: UX checklist: modal copy (explicitly say "unredacted data may include PII"), cost estimate, single-use toggle, approver flow, and a time-left indicator in console when runway active.

alex: One more: for customers in Private deployments, runway tokens must be optionally enforced to route through customer-managed audit hooks (config flag). Document this change in Private upgrade notes.

mira: OK I'll update the RFC with these items and a prototype UI screenshot. Thanks all — pushed draft to https://go.redwood.tools/rfcs/debug-runway (comments welcome). :eyes:

alex: Quick nit — add a short playbook for accidental runway misuse: revoke token + force-redact job + notify tenant + internal postmortem.

sophie: I'll draft the playbook and a console quick-action to revoke active runways.

jonah: +1. If no objections, I'll start the ingest-side PoC for HMAC+nonce tonight.

mira: No objections. Thanks!
